copy.release: The special premiere took place on October 9, 2026 at BlackBox in Beirut Media Zone, as reported by Nidaa al-Watan. VOX Cinemas Lebanon lists the film with a release date of October 21 and sessions at City Centre Beirut. Cinemacity Beirut opened the film on Thursday, October 22. Lebtalks had reported a nationwide Lebanese cinema rollout planned from October 22. An older March 19 database date is not the current release schedule.
copy.status: The October 9, 2026 special premiere has taken place. What cinemas list, and what is still unconfirmed, are separated below.
copy.confirmed: NMPRO and MTV jointly produced the film, directed by Nadim Mehanna with a screenplay by Claudia Marshalian. Jerry Ghazal plays the young Charbel. The October 9 special premiere at Beirut Media Zone has taken place. VOX Cinemas Lebanon lists the film at City Centre Beirut (release date October 21, Arabic audio with English subtitles). Cinemacity Beirut Souks opened the film on Thursday, October 22. Showtimes change, so check sessions with your cinema. A listing is not a seat guarantee.
